patterns.note: Full-width lifestyle imagery serves as section backgrounds, often with left-aligned text overlays and call-to-action buttons.
Product listings utilize a clean grid layout with consistent card styling for each item, including color swatches and pricing.
Call-to-action buttons and some sub-headings consistently use uppercase sans-serif text for emphasis.
A high-contrast color scheme is used, primarily featuring dark text and buttons against light, often white, backgrounds.
A persistent header remains sticky at the top of the viewport as the user scrolls down the page.
A modal pop-up appears on page load, overlaying the content to capture email addresses.

technique_notes: The main navigation and logo are contained within a header element that is fixed to the top of the browser window, maintaining visibility across all scroll depths.
A full-screen modal overlay with a form is triggered to appear on page load, dimming the background content until the user interacts with it or closes it.

Large, high-resolution images are used as full-bleed background elements for content sections, with text and interactive elements positioned over them, often with a subtle text shadow or background to ensure readability.

design_tokens.type_scale: Headings are bold and significantly larger than body text, establishing a clear hierarchy, while body text is clean and highly legible; uppercase is consistently used for CTAs and some labels.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounding (e.g., 4-8px) is applied to buttons and product cards, providing a soft, modern touch without being overly rounded.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy, with generous vertical spacing between major content sections and consistent, ample padding within content blocks and product cards, contributing to a premium feel.

standout: The site's distinctive use of large, aspirational lifestyle photography as full-width section backgrounds creates an immersive and premium brand experience. This approach effectively showcases products within real-world contexts, making the design feel more editorial and less like a typical e-commerce catalog, while maintaining a clean, minimal interface.
